svg.desc: Hunain Ahmed. AI · Software · Products. Turning ambiguous problems into products, intelligent systems and working software. MCP · Cloud Run · PostgreSQL + pgvector · Supabase · Retrieval · Interactive web · Automation. Diagram of how I work: challenge, spec, architect, build, audit, ship, with audit findings looping back into the build. AI toolkit: Claude, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, MCP, Google Antigravity, Gemini, feeding the build stage. Principles: Evidence over assertion. MYSURU, IN · UTC+5:30 · main · hunainx/hunainx.
